verdict.rationale: Gram's own README documents team, server and tool level permissions enforced through RBAC and OAuth 2.1. Its marketing pages describe a catalog of approved tools provisioned by role and say unsanctioned shadow MCP servers are blocked by default, and the MoonPay case study describes permissions scoped per server, per tool and per team. The evidence is mostly README and marketing summaries, not detailed configuration docs. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on configuring per-tool allow/deny rules, independent or hands-on corroboration that per-tool enforcement works.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control
